policy: Seed only. Every row here was fetched by the research box on 2026-10-11 (http field). verification.status unverified means the box got 403, no response or a bot gate: the site exists as far as known but was not read. No row carries copied copy, screenshots, or score text. The build agent writes the original text fields (title, why, palette notes, typography notes, borrow) after opening each site.

sources.name: Awwwards
sources.best_for: Peer-scored winners: Site of the Day, Month, Year, Developer Award, Honorable Mention. Tag pages (GSAP, three.js, WebGL, minimal, e-commerce, real estate, portfolio) are the best discovery path. Site pages list colour palettes and an own-words description.
sources.reuse: Awwwards content (screenshots, scores, texts, jury copy) is theirs, reproduction is prohibited and commercial use needs written consent. Featured sites stay the IP of their creators. Link and describe in our own words only.
sources.notes: The <title> of a site page says SOTD even when the site later won Site of the Year (Lando Norris). The creator profile page shows SOTY 2025.

sources.name: Recent (formerly Godly)
sources.best_for: Daily hand-picked feed of sites, interfaces, branding, motion. It took Godly's place.
sources.reuse: No terms page found (recent.design/terms is 404). Treat as all rights reserved: link and describe only.
sources.notes: godly.website answers 301 to http://recent.design/?ref=godly. recent.design/info says 'Recent also takes the place of Godly'. Our pack's 'godly' source value is legacy. Godly has no public API and no per-site pages we can cite, so the seed has no source=godly rows.

sources.name: GSAP Showcase
sources.best_for: Sites the GSAP team itself picked. Short list, high craft, scroll and timeline work.
sources.reuse: Showcase thumbnails and videos belong to their makers. Link only.
sources.notes: Seven outbound sites verified from the page markup: guillaumecolombel.fr, huyml.co, a24.raviklaassens.com, raviklaassens.com, illoca.unseen.co, jesperlandberg.com, davidlubofsky.com.

sources.name: aura.build
sources.best_for: AI landing page builder with a template and prompt library. Useful as a source of layout patterns and prompts, not as a winners list.
sources.reuse: Generated and template output has its own licence per template. Link only unless a template page says otherwise.
sources.notes: Homepage fetched (200, 'Create Beautiful Landing Pages with AI'). Template listing URLs were not verified. Existing walk code auto-adds up to 2 aura.build rows per round when the pack lists them.

sources.name: Siteinspire
sources.best_for: Long-running curated web design gallery filtered by style and type: minimal, editorial, portfolio, agency.
sources.reuse: Unverified. The research box got HTTP 429 and a Vercel security checkpoint, so terms could not be read. Link only.

sources.name: Minimal Gallery
sources.best_for: Restraint: minimal sites, e-commerce, portfolio, agency, one-page, templates, tools. Running since 2013, acquired 2026.
sources.reuse: Screenshots, thumbnails, curated descriptions and metadata are owned by the gallery. No reproduction, display, scraping or bulk image download without written permission. Personal viewing and bookmarking allowed.

sources.name: Land-book
sources.best_for: Landing pages searchable by style, colour, industry and section type (hero, pricing, about).
sources.reuse: Submitted work stays with creators. Landbook content and data may not be used for ML training or commercial reuse without consent. Bots, crawlers and scrapers are prohibited.

sources.name: Lapa Ninja
sources.best_for: Large landing page collection (about 7,300) and font, template and resource lists. Useful for SaaS and product pages.
sources.reuse: No terms page found (/terms/ is 404). Link only.

sources.name: Httpster
sources.best_for: Hand-picked, personality-heavy sites: agencies, portfolios, indie shops.
sources.reuse: No reuse terms read. Link only.

sources.name: CSS Design Awards
sources.best_for: Daily awards with UI, UX and innovation scores. Good second opinion to Awwwards.
sources.reuse: Creator keeps copyright. Site content not submitted by users may not be reproduced without authority. Link and describe only.
sources.notes: Homepage returned HTTP 202 to curl (bot gate). Terms page fetched.

sources.name: The FWA
sources.best_for: Long-running interactive and campaign awards (FOTD, FOTM, FOTY). Strong for WebGL and experiential work.
sources.reuse: No terms page found at /terms. Link only.

sources.name: Mobbin
sources.best_for: Real app UI and flow screenshots for web and mobile product patterns.
sources.reuse: Paid platform. Terms forbid scraping, mirroring, caching or re-hosting materials, and say screenshots belong to their IP holders. Never copy or cache. Link and describe only.

sources.name: Refero
sources.best_for: Searchable real UI screens and flows from live products, plus style references. Also exposed through the Refero MCP in this workspace.
sources.reuse: Terms URL not found (/terms returned 200 but is the app shell). Treat screenshots as third-party. Link and describe only.

sources.name: Dribbble and Behance
sources.best_for: Concept shots and case studies. Not used for the walk: shots are mockups, not live sites, and each shot is the designer's copyright.
sources.reuse: Not researched. Out of scope on purpose.

sources.name: Codrops
sources.best_for: Tutorials and demos for GSAP, three.js, shaders. Source of how an effect is built.
sources.reuse: Demos ship under a stated licence per article. Link only here.
